# Daylight

> A macOS menu bar utility that shifts your display's warmth and brightness on a
> schedule you control. Works offline. No account, no network requests, no location
> permission.

One page of static HTML. The schedule demo on the page is the app's own engine
running in the browser, so every number it shows is computed locally.

## On this page

- [How it works](https://daylight-app-wine.vercel.app/#how): the schedule, the layer ladder, and what decides a value.
- [Details](https://daylight-app-wine.vercel.app/#detail): solar times without a location prompt, display identity, the menu bar panel.
- [What it does not claim](https://daylight-app-wine.vercel.app/#honest): software dimming, not backlight control; not notarised.
- [Download](https://daylight-app-wine.vercel.app/#download): macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel.
